description: This file contains unit tests for the BuzzDao class within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin. It verifies functionalities such as retrieving, saving, and deleting Buzz posts, shares, photos, videos, and comments, as well as filtering and counting these entities. The test class extends KernelTestCase and uses mock services to test database interactions and data manipulations related to the Buzz feature.

classes.name: BuzzDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing BuzzDao functionalities such as create, read, update, delete (CRUD) operations for Buzz posts, shares, comments, photos, videos, and filters.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures from YAML configuration before each test execution.

methods.name: testGetBuzzFeedPosts
methods.description: Tests fetching of buzz feed posts with specified filter parameters and verifies content correctness.

methods.name: testGetBuzzFeedPostsCount
methods.description: Verifies counting of buzz feed posts based on filter applied.

methods.name: testGetBuzzPhotoIdsByPostId
methods.description: Checks retrieval of photo IDs associated with a specific post ID.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzPost
methods.description: Tests saving a new BuzzPost entity and verifies its attributes post-save.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzShare
methods.description: Tests saving a BuzzShare entity linked to a BuzzPost, verifying attributes.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzVideo
methods.description: Tests saving a BuzzLink (video) linked to a BuzzPost and verifies data integrity.

methods.name: testSaveBuzzPhotos
methods.description: Tests saving a BuzzPhoto entity with image data, then retrieves and verifies it.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzPost1
methods.description: Verifies deletion of a BuzzPost and associated shares.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzPost2
methods.description: Checks cascading delete for BuzzPost and associated shares/photos.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzPost3
methods.description: Further cascade delete test, including links.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzShare
methods.description: Verifies deletion of a BuzzShare and its indirect effects on related entities.

methods.name: testDeleteBuzzShare2
methods.description: Another cascade delete verification, including related links.

methods.name: testGetBuzzShareByPostId
methods.description: Checks retrieval of BuzzShare entity by post ID.

methods.name: testGetBuzzPostSharesList1
methods.description: Tests retrieval of BuzzPostShare list filtered by post ID.

methods.name: testGetBuzzPostSharesList2
methods.description: Verifies empty list when no shares are found for a post.

methods.name: testGetBuzzPostSharesCount1
methods.description: Checks count of shares for a specific post.

methods.name: testGetBuzzPostSharesCount2
methods.description: Verifies zero count when no shares exist for a post.

methods.name: testGetBuzzCommentById
methods.description: Tests fetching a specific comment by share and comment IDs.

methods.name: testGetBuzzComments
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of comments filtered by share ID.

methods.name: testGetBuzzCommentsCount
methods.description: Verifies count of comments for a specific share.
